newsitem.title: UK: Forties crude to load 26.4 mln barrels in February.
newsitem.headline: Forties crude to load 26.4 mln barrels in February.

text.p: About 26.4 million barrels of North Sea Forties crude oil are scheduled to load in February compared to 28.8 million barrels in January, traders said.

The February programme, released to equity producers early on Tuesday, includes one million-barrel cargo, one 900,000-barrel cargo, 21 cargoes of 600,000 barrels each and 21 cargoes of 500,000 barrels each. An additional 1.4 million barrels is destined for operator BP's Grangemouth refinery.

In January, the programme consisted of one cargo of one million barrels, one 650,000 barrel cargo, 26 cargoes of 600,000 barrels each, 20 cargoes of 500,000 barrels and 1.55 million barrels to Grangemouth.

Though the outright amount scheduled to hit the market in February is lower than in January, in barrel per day terms, it is higher because February is a shorter month, traders said. --Karen Matusic, London newsroom, +44 171 542 6280. Tuesday, 14 January 1997 07:40:24 ENDS nFLLOEE010
